title: Conformance vector
description: One message and what it decodes to. Decoding the bytes produces the fields, and encoding the fields reproduces the bytes exactly. Vectors live in conformance/vectors/<message-name>/<case>.json, the directory named in kebab-case after the message it covers.

message.description: Identity of the message these bytes carry.

version.description: Client version the message was taken from. Selects the revision.

bytes.description: The message, in hexadecimal, whitespace ignored. Bytes that identify a person are zeroed before committing.

fields.description: The decoded value of every field the revision defines. A byte run is hexadecimal, and an unsigned 64 bit value is a decimal string, because JSON cannot hold one exactly as a number.
